# Prism (vendored browser bundle)

Classic-script Prism bundle for Utility Editor code highlighting.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Library | PrismJS |

| Bundle | `prism.js` |

This is the standard classic browser bundle with markup, CSS, clike, and JavaScript grammars. It does not require a module loader.
